# External schema provenance

`server.schema.json` is the official generated MCP server schema downloaded from https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json on 2026-10-13. Upstream https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry is transitioning from MIT to Apache-2.0; documentation is CC-BY-4.0 and earlier un-relicensed contributions remain MIT. The full upstream license notice is retained in MCP-REGISTRY-LICENSE.txt. These external fixtures are not claimed as original CAD2GIS code.

`glama.schema.json` is the public maintainer metadata schema from https://glama.ai/mcp/schemas/server.json on 2026-10-13. Its original schema ID and descriptions are retained for attribution and compatibility validation.
